content.short: Zeeve provides enterprise-grade zkRollups and OP Rollups infrastructure through a no-code platform.
content.description: Zeeve is a Rollup-as-a-Service platform that enables the deployment and ongoing management of enterprise-grade L2 or L3 rollups. It provides flexible configuration, scalable node infrastructure, and security best practices, along with 24/7 monitoring and technical support under an Enterprise SLA. Zeeve also fosters a strong partner ecosystem to extend the capabilities of Optimistic and ZK Rollups, helping teams accelerate multi-chain rollup implementations.
content.meta: Zeeve is a Rollup-as-a-Service platform enabling enterprise-grade L2 or L3 Rollups. Discover Zeeve and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
